title: LowPack: local-first application-aware lossless packing for archives
description:
Overview

LowPack is a local-first command-line tool and Python library for deterministic, application-aware, lossless archive packing. It prepares data according to an explicit profile and uses established store, zlib, and Zstandard codecs.

Capabilities

  • Packs, lists, inspects, verifies, explains, extracts, and unpacks .lpk archives.
  • Provides general, source, and telemetry profiles with recorded decisions.
  • Deduplicates identical chunks, validates extraction paths, and supports checked migration of format 1.0 archives.
  • Exposes typed Python functions for archive workflows.

Install/Deploy

Install the versioned wheel with Python 3.9 through 3.14.

python -m pip install https://github.com/devkyato/Lowpack/releases/download/v0.2.3/lowpack-0.2.3-py3-none-any.whl
lowpack --version
lowpack doctor

Quick start

lowpack pack project -o project.lpk --profile source
lowpack inspect project.lpk
lowpack verify project.lpk --full
lowpack unpack project.lpk -o restored

Applications

  • Reproducible source-tree archives.
  • Offline backup and transfer bundles.
  • Lossless telemetry and experiment artifact packaging.
  • Coursework and research data archives.

Limitations/status

LowPack 0.2.3 is alpha software and the format has no forward-compatibility promise across alpha releases. It does not claim to outperform general-purpose codecs. Symlinks, encryption, signatures, split archives, and append mode are not supported; important data needs another independent copy.
